paite: Tiberias Kaisar vaihawm akum sawm-le-nga kum in, Judia gam ukpa Pontias Pilat ahi a, Galili gam kumpipa Herod ahi a, a-unau Philip, Ituria leh Trakoniti gam kumpipa ahi a, Abilin gam kumpipa Lusania ahi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Leh Athupuak / (Mat 3.1-12; Mar 1.1-8; Joh 1.19-28)
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

paite: Annas leh Kaiapha siampu lianpen ahi ua, huai lai in gamdai ah Zakariah tapa Johan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

paite: Amah bel Jordan lui gei kim gam tengteng ah ahoh a, thil hihkhial ngaihdamna ding in kisikna baptisma thu agen zel hi.
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

paite: Zawlnei Isai laibu a: "Gamdai a kikou aw in, Toupa lampi sial unla, alampite tangsak un.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

paite: Guam chih sundim ahi ding a, tang leh mual chih, hihniam ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, lampi phokte mamsak ahi ding.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh," achi, chih gelh bang in.
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

paite: Ama'n baptisma tang ding akiang a mipi hong sukte kiang ah, "Nou gul suante aw, thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon vauhilh ahia?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

paite: Huchi in kisik minputak in gah un, ei hon suangpa Abraham ahi na lungsim un chi kei un; Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

paite: Tu mahmah in singbul teng ah heipi koih ahita; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhmah phuk in a-om a, mei ah paih in a-om," achi hi.
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

paite: Huan mipite'n akiang ah, "Bang ka hihta ding ua?" chi in adong uhi.
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh puanak nih nei in anei lou kiang ah hawm hen; kuapeuh an nei in huchibang mah in hih hen," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

paite: Huan siahkhon mite leng baptisma tang ding in ahong ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, bang ka hih ding ua?" achi uhi.
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon sehsak val uh khon kei un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

paite: Sepaihte'n leng akiang ah, "Kou leng bang ka hih ding ua?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuamah hiamgam in hih kei unla, dikloupi in kuamah hek kei unla, na loh uah lungkim un," achi hi.
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

paite: Huan mite'n alamet ua, mi tengteng in Johan tungthu alungtang ua, Khrist ahi kha zenzen diam aw? chi a angaihtuah lai un,
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

paite: Johan in adawng a, avek ua kiang ah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh kei sang a mithupizaw ahong pai ding, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei; ama'n Kha Siangthou leh mei in nou ahon baptis ding.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

paite: Akhut in aphazah atawi a, aphual zapsianna ding leh buhpang a buhte sunlutna ding in; asite mei mit ngei lou ah ahalmang ding," achi hi.
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

paite: Huan hanthawnna tampi in mite kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh zel hi.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

paite: Himahleh kumpipa Herod in anaupa zi, Herodias tungthu ah leh athilhihkhelh tung a Johan in ataihilh ziak in,
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

paite: athilhihkhelh tengteng behlap in amah suangkul ah akhum hi.
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

paite: Huan mi tengteng abaptis zoh in, hichi ahong hi a, Jesu leng baptis zoh a a-om in, athum a, van ahong kihong a,
heading: Jesu Baptisna / (Mat 3.13-17; Mar 1.9-11)
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

paite: Kha Siangthou sa pu in vakhu bang in ahong suk a, atung ah atuta a; van a kipan in aw ahong pawt a, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi; na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n thu ahilh pat tung lai in amah kum sawmthum vel ahita, mi ngaih in zaw Joseph tapa ahi a, huai Heli tapa ahi a,
heading: Jesu Khangsutna / (Mat 1.1-17)
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

paite: huai Matthat tapa ahi a, huai Levi tapa ahi a, huai Melki tapa ahi a, huai Janna tapa ahi a, huai Joseph tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

paite: huai Matthathias tapa ahi a, huai Amos tapa ahi a, huai Nahum tapa ahi a, huai Esli tapa ahi a, huai Naggai tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

paite: huai Maathi tapa ahi a, huai Matthathias tapa ahi a, huai Semmei tapa ahi a, huai Josek tapa ahi a, huai Joda tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

paite: huai Joanan tapa ahi a, huai Rhesa tapa ahi a, huai Zerubbabel tapa ahi a, huai Salathiel tapa ahi a, huai Neri tapa ahi,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

paite: huai Melki tapa ahi, huai Addi tapa ahi, huai Kosam tapa ahi, huai Elmadam tapa ahi, huai Er tapa ahi,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

paite: huai Joses tapa ahi a, huai Eliezer tapa ahi a, huai Jorim tapa ahi a, huai Matthat tapa ahi,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

paite: huai Levi tapa ahi a; huai Simeon tapa ahi, huai Judah tapa ahi, huai Joseph tapa ahi, huai Jonam tapa ahi, huai Eliakim tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

paite: huai Melia tapa ahi, huai Menna tapa ahi, huai Mattatha tapa ahi a, huai Nathan tapa ahi, huai David tapa ahi,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

paite: huai Jesse tapa ahi, huai Obed tapa ahi a, huai Boaz tapa ahi a, huai Salmon tapa ahi a, huai Nahshon tapa ahi,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

paite: huai Amminadab tapa ahi a, huai Admin tapa ahi, huai Arni tapa ahi a, huai Hezron tapa ahi, huai Perez tapa ahi a, huai Judah tapa ahi,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

paite: huai Jakob tapa ahi a, huai Isak tapa ahi, huai Abraham tapa ahi a, huai Tera tapa ahi a, huai Nahor tapa ahi.
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

paite: Huai Serug tapa ahi, huai Reu tapa ahi, huai Peleg tapa ahi, huai Eber tapa ahi, huai Selah tapa ahi,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

paite: huai Kainan tapa ahi, huai Arpakshad tapa ahi, huai Sem tapa ahi, huai Noah tapa ahi, huai Lamekh tapa ahi,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

paite: huai Methuselah tapa ahi, huai Enok tapa ahi, huai Jared tapa ahi, huai Mahalalel tapa ahi, huai Kainan tapa ahi,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

paite: huai Enos tapa ahi, huai Seth tapa ahi, huai Adam tapa ahi, huai Pathian tapa ahi.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
